memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "They made two gold rings below the moulding - two on each of the opposite sides - to hold the poles used to carry it. They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold." - Exod 37:27-28 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Even the altar of incense had poles. Wherever Israel went, the place of prayer went with them.

That is not a small detail. Israel would camp in dozens of places over forty years — some pleasant, most difficult. In every one, the altar of prayer was set up again.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where do you find it hardest to pray?
2. Do you turn to prayer immediately, or only after other options fail?
3. What would praying "continually" look like in your ordinary day?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that I can pray anywhere. Make prayer my first instinct rather than my last resort. Amen.
